fields.rt-blog-html:
After a year of confinement, the reopening of the restaurants on May 19 has finally been announced!

The resumption, so much awaited by a population avid for freedom, will be carried out initially by the reception of the customers in terrace... of what to benefit from the beautiful days which arrive.

With the arrival of this clientele, who are only waiting for one thing: to come back and consume on the spot, how can you anticipate their return, organize yourselves as well as possible and not let yourself be surprised?

With Click & Collect and delivery having been the most popular modes of consumption since the beginning of the health crisis, the efficiency of online ordering and this is not the time to abandon it! So capitalize on this great channel to also respond effectively to on-site ordering!

Online ordering is a good way to get back to business with peace of mind.

A tool is more important than ever, we do not present it to you anymore... the QR code! Well-known in the industry, it is what will allow you to start again smoothly and to organize yourself better in the kitchen.

It couldn't be simpler: create a unique QR code redirecting to your online order, print it and put it on each of your tables.

Many online tools offer it for free, so you have a lot to choose from: unitag, QRCode Monkey, QR Code Generator, Shopify QR Code Generator, QR Stuffetc.

Your customers are autonomous

Your customers sitting comfortably on the terrace will be able to scan this flashcode with their smartphone and access the catalog that you offer online.

With the ordering platform Innovorder, a menu entirely customized to your image and easily modifiable is made available to them. All they have to do is consult it and place their order from their mobile.

Thanks to Click & Serve, it is even possible to ask for the table number at which they are seated to facilitate your service!

Automated and secure payment

No more resto-baskets! With online ordering, allow your customers to pay directly and simply online via their smartphone.

Vary also the means of payment to make their life easier: offer them to pay by bank card (Visa, MasterCard or other) and by dematerialized meal voucher (Swile/Lunchr, RestoFlash, Apetiz, Chèque Déjeuner, or even Pass restaurant).

No chance of forgetting with these numerous payment options, offered easily!

Increase your average ticket effortlessly

The digitalized path of the online ordering Innovorder allows you to offer your customers additional products at the end of the order process, in a very visual way.

Would you like to have a dessert? A little extra coffee to extend your tan on the terrace? Upselling is child's play. This module allows you to increase your average ticket by 25% via this channel.

Organize like a boss

Once the orders are placed by your customers in a 100% digitalized way, they are automatically distributed wherever you want. You can either receive them on your Innovorder cash register, automatically linked to the table plan:

Don't hesitate any longer, get help from now on to set up your online order to anticipate your reopening!
